title: A card's more-actions menu on hover or focus includes Reassign lead
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Location has several eligible technicians (Clockable, Active, role not Office / not Time Clock User, enrolled here) and seeded work orders spread across statuses (Estimate, Approved, In Progress, Review/Ready for Review, Complete, Invoiced, Paid, Declined, Imported), including at least one with no lead technician.
  5. In Board View.
custom_steps:
1. Switch to Board View.
  2. Hover a card (and move keyboard focus to it).
  3. Confirm the more-actions control appears.
  4. Open it and confirm it lists Reassign lead technician.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A card's more-actions menu appears when you hover the card or move keyboard focus to it.
  • The card's more-actions menu includes "Reassign lead technician".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10046 — Story 3 Board View. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S3-R13, S3-R14 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R13: “Reveal the card’s more-actions overlay on hover or keyboard focus.”
  • S3-R14: “Include Reassign lead technician in the card’s more-actions menu.”
